questions.label: What services do you offer?
questions.content: I offer a range of services including web design, web development, branding, and creative design. I can also help with SEO and social media marketing.

questions.label: Can you teach me how to make a website?
questions.content: I don't offer courses at the moment, but I can recommend resources and advice to help you get the most out of your learning.

questions.label: How much does a project cost?
questions.content: The cost of a project varies based on several factors, including its size, features, and development time. Let's discuss your project and I'll give you a quote.

questions.label: How does payment work for a project?
questions.content: I ask for a 40% deposit before starting a project, and the remaining 60% after successful delivery. I accept payments by bank transfer, PayPal, etc...

questions.label: How long does a project take?
questions.content: It's difficult to give an exact estimate, as each project is different, but the majority of my past work has taken between 2 weeks and 2 months.

questions.label: Do you offer discounts?
questions.content: I offer a 15% discount for students and non-profit organizations.

questions.label: What do you enjoy most about this work?
questions.content: What I enjoy most is the blend of creativity and problem-solving. The ability to take an idea - whether through design, development, or painting - and transform it into something visually striking and functional is incredibly rewarding. Every project is a new challenge, an opportunity to push boundaries and create something that resonates. Seeing the final result come to life and knowing it engages, inspires, or solves a problem makes the process exciting every time.

questions.label: Hobbies outside of work?
questions.content: Since I am passionate about my work, I dedicate a significant amount of time to my projects. However, I also have a deep love for the outdoors. I enjoy running, going to the gym, and swimming to stay active. Beyond that, I find inspiration in painting and reading - both fuel my creativity and bring balance to my life.
